valores.label: Gov. Bill Walker announces preference for No Action; project cut from the budget (Dec. 15, 2016)

legenda: Walker's press release of Dec. 15, 2016, as recorded in the 2018 study.
narracao: In December 2016, Governor Bill Walker said he preferred what the study calls the No Action alternative… He cited the state's fiscal crisis.

conferencia.prova: "Governor Bill Walker articulated the State's fiscal circumstances in a press release dated December 15, 2016, announcing that he preferred Alternative 1 – No Action and that the JAI Project was being cut from the budget. He stated, 'I am a builder by background … but I am very concerned with our current multi-billion dollar fiscal crisis…'"
